All tested features working correctly: Profile button shows 'Your Baseline' instead of user name, Quick Stats correctly displays calories/protein from nutrition API (data.totals.calories), hydration from hydration API (data.total_ml), and steps from biometrics API (data.steps). Dashboard reorganized with 6 primary cards and collapsible 'More Features' section with secondary cards.
